title: Sequence of Tenses in Formal Reports
goal: Report requests and decisions in formal prose with the right subjunctive after a past verb or a present perfect.

items: I can report a request in the past with the imperfect subjunctive (*pidió que se revisara*).
I can report a current request with the present subjunctive after *ha pedido* (*ha pedido que se revise*).
I can use the new words for committees and their documents in a short formal report.
